description: Arabic speech recognition optimized across dialects and accents; the default model.

meta.max_duration_note: Files under 60 minutes; live streaming unbounded
meta.streaming_encodings: linear16, mulaw, alaw at 8000 or 16000 Hz (WSS /api/v1/listen)

name: Munsit

pricing.notes: Wallet credits: 100 credits per minute of audio (20,000 credits = $1), same rate for munsit and munsit-en-ar; +10 credits/min each for diarize, return_gender, return_sentiment on POST /audio/transcribe ($0.33-$0.39 per hour); live streaming billed at the base rate per channel. Price list version 2026-11. Note: munsit.com/pricing plan allowances (e.g. 200k credits ~ 200 transcription minutes) imply a higher per-minute credit rate than the API docs.

variants.applies_to: one paid option (diarize, gender or sentiment)
